entities.name: HmsA
observations: pPCP1-encoded 65-nt small regulatory RNA, also called sR084, in Yersinia pestis.

entities.name: PMID:27492011
observations: Liu et al. (2016) reported HmsA contributes to enhanced Yersinia pestis biofilm formation; hmsA deletion significantly reduced c-di-GMP and HmsA positively regulated biofilm synthesis-associated genes.

entities.name: HmsA promotes biofilm
observations: In Yersinia pestis, HmsA contributes to enhanced biofilm formation; hmsA deletion reduced c-di-GMP, while HmsA positively regulated hmsHFRS, hmsT, and hmsCDE expression.
